title: Estadio GNP Seguros rolls out sensory vest-led accessible area
summary: Expanding on OCESA’s sensory vest scheme, Mexico’s Estadio GNP Seguros has introduced a new accessible area in the venue, complete with vest use and sign language interpretation services. title: Ticketmaster’s new Uruguay business to be run from Chile
summary: Following its expansion into Uruguay last month, Ticketmaster’s new operation in the country is to be run from Santiago, Chile, the company’s general manager for Chile has said.
